hh_ethnologue_comment.comment:
E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 has a separate entry for Barababaraba [rbp]. But Barababaraba [rbp] belongs to the Wembawemba branch of a large set of named varieties close enough to be the same language which may be called Western Victoria
(**hh:e:Beveridge:Riverina**, **hh:hw:Hercus:Victoria:1969**, **hh:w:Ridley:Kamilaroi:1875**). See also: Western Victoria [NOCODE_Western-Victoria].
